name: Sociedad Química y Minera de Chile S.A.
content: Sociedad Química y Minera de Chile S.A. (SQM) is a global mining and chemical company based in Chile, recognized as a world leader in the production of lithium, iodine, and specialty plant nutrients. The company operates in northern Chile's Atacama Desert, where it extracts high-grade caliche and brine deposits. SQM plays a critical role in the global energy transition by providing high-quality lithium chemicals essential for electric vehicle batteries and energy storage systems. Additionally, it is a major producer of potassium nitrate and solar salts, serving diverse industries including agriculture, healthcare, and renewable energy.

Officers

Ricardo Ramos Rodríguez(Date: 2019 January)

Chief Executive Officer

Mr. Ramos joined the Company in 1989. He has served as our Chief Executive Officer since January 1, 2019. Previously, he served as our Chief Financial Officer and as our Vice President of Corporate Development and Business Development. He is a Chilean citizen and holds a degree in industrial engineering from the Pontificia Universidad Católica de Chile.

Gerardo Illanes Gani(Date: 2019 January)

Chief Financial Officer

Mr. Illanes joined the Company in 2006. He has served as our Chief Financial Officer since January 1, 2019. Previously, he served as our Vice President of Finance and as our Finance Manager. He is a Chilean citizen and holds a degree in industrial engineering from the Pontificia Universidad Católica de Chile.

Carlos Díaz Castellón(Date: 2018 January)

Executive Vice President of Lithium

Mr. Díaz joined the Company in 1996. He has served as our Executive Vice President of Lithium since 2018. Previously, he served as our Vice President of Operations and as our Vice President of Logistics and Supply Chain. He is a Chilean citizen and holds a degree in industrial engineering from the Pontificia Universidad Católica de Chile.

Gonzalo Aguirre(Date: 2018 January)

Executive Vice President of Iodine and Industrial Chemicals

Mr. Aguirre joined the Company in 1994. He has served as our Executive Vice President of Iodine and Industrial Chemicals since 2018. He is a Chilean citizen and holds a degree in industrial engineering from the Pontificia Universidad Católica de Chile.

Pablo Altimiras(Date: 2018 January)

Executive Vice President of Nitrates and Potassium

Mr. Altimiras joined the Company in 2007. He has served as our Executive Vice President of Nitrates and Potassium since 2018. He is a Chilean citizen and holds a degree in industrial engineering from the Pontificia Universidad Católica de Chile.

Directors

Gonzalo Guerrero Yamamoto(Date: 2022 April)

Chairman of the Board

Mr. Guerrero has been a director since 2016 and Chairman of the Board since 2022. He is a lawyer and holds a law degree from the Universidad de Chile and an MBA from the Universidad Adolfo Ibáñez.

Patricio Contesse Fica(Date: 2022 April)

Vice Chairman of the Board

Mr. Contesse Fica has been a director since 2013 and Vice Chairman of the Board since 2022. He is a lawyer and holds a law degree from the Pontificia Universidad Católica de Chile.

Hernán Büchi Buc(Date: 2017 April)

Director

Mr. Büchi has been a director since 2017. He is a civil engineer and holds a degree from the Universidad de Chile and an MBA from Columbia University. He served as Chile's Minister of Finance from 1985 to 1989.

Ashley Ozols(Date: 2022 April)

Director

Mr. Ozols has been a director since 2022. He is a citizen of Australia and holds a Bachelor of Commerce from the University of New South Wales. He has extensive experience in the mining and finance sectors.

Antonio Schneider Chaigneau(Date: 2022 April)

Independent Director

Mr. Schneider has been a director since 2022. He is an economist and holds a degree from the Universidad de Chile. He has served on various boards of directors in Chile and abroad.

Gina Ocqueteau Tacchini(Date: 2023 April)

Director

Ms. Ocqueteau has been a director since 2023. She is a nurse and holds a degree from the Universidad de Chile and an MBA from the Universidad Adolfo Ibáñez. She has experience in health management and corporate sustainability.

Xu Tieying(Date: 2023 April)

Director

Mr. Xu has been a director since 2023. He is a citizen of the People's Republic of China and holds a degree in economics from the University of International Business and Economics in Beijing. He has extensive experience in the chemical industry.

Antonio Gil Nievas(Date: 2023 April)

Independent Director

Mr. Gil Nievas has been a director since 2023. He is a citizen of Spain and holds a degree in industrial engineering from the Universidad Pontificia Comillas and an MBA from Harvard Business School. He has experience in global finance and investment.
